entry_point: pytools menu → 7 → 6 (explicit append confirmation) → pytools extract-sheets --append-existing

contract.formula_mode: cached values for ordinary extraction; formula text is not copied
contract.comments: not copied into newly extracted sheets; existing target comments are preserved by the tested capability

interactive_menu.missing_capability_or_platform: refused before source selection; existing output unchanged
interactive_menu.existing_output_protection: existing values, formula text, comments, and merged ranges preserved

synthetic_cases.case: area extraction into existing result from a previous run
checks: target bytes unchanged when capability is absent
target bytes unchanged when platform does not match
run history excludes raw cell values

synthetic_cases.case: full-sheet extraction into an existing workbook
checks: existing value, formula text, comment, merge, bold style, row height, and column width
new sheet stored values, merge, bold style, row height, and column width
ordinary extraction omits formula text and comments from the new sheet

limitations: Synthetic XLSX fixtures only; no authorized real business workbook used.
The legacy Python append test covers area extraction only; no full-sheet Python output-file parity is claimed.
Interactive append was validated only with synthetic XLSX and a temporary test capability; no production capability is registered.
No production Passed capability has been registered.
Other Excel formats, Windows file dialog interaction, Kylin/UOS glibc 2.28, and offline deb validation remain unverified.
